meaning: Today I am feeling very happy.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱠᱟᱛᱷᱟ ᱟᱸᱡᱚᱢ ᱛᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱤᱧ ᱟᱹᱭᱠᱟᱹᱣ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Amag katha anjom te adi napay iny aykaw keda.
meaning: I felt very pleasant hearing your words.
Do not worry, everything will be alright.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱞᱟᱸᱜᱟ ᱮᱱᱟᱹᱧ᱾
sentenceLatin: Kami te iny do langa enany.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱜᱤᱫᱽᱨᱟᱹ ᱫᱚ ᱠᱷᱮᱞᱚᱸᱰ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱠᱩᱥᱤ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱭᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Gidra do khelond re adi kusi menaya.
meaning: The child is very pleased in playing.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱢᱮᱫ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱮᱫ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱪᱮᱫᱟᱜ?
sentenceLatin: Amag med re med dag cedag?
meaning: Why are there tears in your eyes?
Move forward with a courageous heart.
Do not be angry, hold compassion.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱞᱮ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱢ ᱧᱮᱞ ᱛᱮ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱨᱟᱹᱥᱠᱟᱹ ᱞᱮ ᱧᱟᱢ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Ale do am nyel te adi raska le nyam keda.
meaning: We felt great delight seeing you.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱠᱟᱛᱷᱟ ᱨᱚᱲ ᱞᱮᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱢᱚᱱᱮ ᱥᱟᱯᱷᱟ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Sari katha ror lekhan mone sapha tahena.
meaning: Speaking truth keeps the mind clear.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱢ ᱫᱚ ᱪᱮᱫᱟᱜ ᱮᱢ ᱵᱚᱛᱚᱨᱚᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
sentenceLatin: Am do cedag em botorog kana?

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱯᱟᱹᱨᱥᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱨᱚᱲ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱜᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱠᱟᱛᱷᱟ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Santali parsi te ror do adi gorob reyag katha kana.
meaning: Speaking in the Santali language is a matter of great pride.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱟᱢ ᱨᱮ ᱯᱟᱹᱛᱭᱟᱹᱣ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜᱼᱛᱤᱧᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Iny do am re patyaw menag-tiny-a.
meaning: I have trust and faith in you.
May there be peace in your heart.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱡᱚᱦᱟᱨ ᱜᱚᱢᱠᱮ, ᱫᱮᱞᱟ ᱵᱷᱤᱛᱨᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱦᱤᱡᱩᱜ ᱵᱤᱱ᱾
sentenceLatin: Johar gomke, dela bhitri te hijug bin.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱢᱟ ᱫᱩᱲᱩᱵ ᱵᱤᱱ, ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱩ ᱵᱤᱱ᱾
sentenceLatin: Ma durub bin, dag nyu bin.
meaning: Please take a seat and drink water.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱥᱟᱨᱦᱟᱣ ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱫᱟᱭᱟ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ᱾
sentenceLatin: Adi adi sarhaw amag daya lagid.
meaning: Thank you very much for your kindness.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱤᱧ ᱤᱠᱟᱹ ᱠᱟᱹᱧ ᱢᱮ, ᱵᱤᱞᱚᱢ ᱮᱱᱟᱹᱧ᱾
sentenceLatin: Iny ika kany me, bilom enany.
meaning: Please forgive me, I got delayed.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱫᱟᱭᱟ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱟᱨ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱫᱷᱟᱣ ᱞᱟᱹᱭ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Daya kate ar mid dhaw lay me.
meaning: Please say that one more time.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱢ ᱚᱠᱟ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱮᱢ ᱦᱮᱡ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
sentenceLatin: Am oka khon em hej akana?

sentenceOlChiki: ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱫᱩᱢᱠᱟᱹ ᱠᱷᱚᱱᱤᱧ ᱦᱮᱡ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Iny do Dumka khoniny hej akana.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱯᱮ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱠᱚ ᱵᱮᱥ ᱜᱮᱭᱟ ᱛᱚ?
sentenceLatin: Ape orag re sanam ko bes geya to?
meaning: Is everyone well at your home?

sentenceOlChiki: ᱦᱚᱭ, ᱟᱞᱮ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱠᱚ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱜᱮ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱜ ᱞᱮᱭᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Hoy, ale orag re sanam ko napay ge menag leya.
meaning: Yes, everyone in our house is doing well.
Then I shall take my leave, farewell.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱮᱱᱚᱜ ᱢᱮ, ᱟᱨᱦᱚᱸ ᱦᱤᱡᱩᱜ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Napay te senog me, arho hijug me.
meaning: Go safely and do visit again.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱜᱚᱲᱚ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤ ᱠᱷᱟᱱ ᱞᱟᱹᱭ ᱟᱹᱧ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Goro lakti khan lay any me.
meaning: If you need help, let me know.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱹᱜᱩᱱ ᱦᱚᱨ, ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱮᱴᱮᱨᱚᱜ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Sagun hor, napay te seterog me.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱩᱱᱤ ᱫᱚ ᱨᱩᱣᱟᱹ ᱛᱮ ᱜᱤᱛᱤᱡ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟᱭ᱾
sentenceLatin: Uni do ruwa te gitij akana.
meaning: He is lying down due to fever.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱦᱚᱲᱢᱚ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱟᱲᱮ ᱫᱚᱦᱚᱭ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱡᱚᱢ ᱧᱩ ᱵᱮᱥ ᱫᱚᱦᱚᱭ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Hormo re dare dohoy lagid jom nyu bes dohoy me.
meaning: Maintain good nutrition to keep strength in the body.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱢᱮᱫ ᱨᱮ ᱪᱮᱫ ᱪᱚᱝ ᱵᱚᱞᱚ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Med re ched chong bolo akana.

meaning: There is a slight thorn in my foot.
Take rest, you will recover soon.
Brush and clean your teeth daily.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱱᱤᱛᱚᱜ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱮᱥ ᱜᱮᱧ ᱟᱹᱭᱠᱟᱹᱣ ᱮᱫᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Nitog do bes geny aykaw eda.
meaning: Now I am feeling quite well.
I am feeling very thirsty for water.
I am feeling hungry, I will eat food.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱦᱚᱲᱢᱚ ᱨᱮ ᱨᱩᱣᱟᱹ ᱵᱟᱹᱱᱩᱜᱼᱟ, ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱜᱮ ᱢᱮᱱᱟᱹᱧᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Hormo re ruwa banug-a, napay ge menanya.
meaning: There is no fever in the body, I am fine.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱞᱮ ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱮ ᱢᱟᱺᱡᱷᱤ ᱦᱟᱲᱟᱢ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱤᱪᱟᱹᱨ ᱮᱫᱟᱭ᱾
sentenceLatin: Ale atu re Manjhi haram do bicar eday.
meaning: In our village, the village chief (Manjhi Haram) leads the council meeting.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱠᱷᱲᱟ ᱨᱮ ᱴᱟᱢᱟᱠ ᱟᱨ ᱛᱩᱢᱫᱟᱜ ᱨᱩᱻᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Akhra re Tamak ar Tumdak rug kana.
meaning: In the dancing ground, the Tamak and Tumdak drums are beating.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱠᱩᱲᱤ ᱠᱚ ᱫᱚ ᱞᱟᱜᱽᱬᱮ ᱮᱱᱮᱡ ᱨᱮ ᱠᱚ ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Kuri ko do Lagre enej re ko seled akana.
meaning: The women have joined the graceful Lagre dance.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱡᱟᱦᱮᱨ ᱛᱷᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱵᱳᱝᱜᱟ ᱵᱳᱨᱳ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Jaher Than re bonga buru huyug kana.
meaning: Sacred worship is taking place at the Jaher Than grove.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱚᱦᱨᱟᱭ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱫᱚ ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲ ᱠᱚᱣᱟᱜ ᱢᱟᱨᱟᱝ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Sohrai Porob do Santhal kowag marang porob kana.
meaning: Sohrai festival is the grandest harvest celebration of the Santal people.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱵᱟᱦᱟ ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱨᱡᱚᱢ ᱵᱟᱦᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱦᱟᱹᱴᱤᱧᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Baha Porob re Sarjom baha ko hatinya.
meaning: During the Baha festival, sacred Sal blossoms are distributed.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱹᱛᱩ ᱨᱤᱱ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱦᱚᱲ ᱢᱤᱫ ᱢᱚᱱᱮ ᱛᱮ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱ ᱯᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Atu rin sanam hor mid mone te tahen pe.
meaning: May all people of the village live with unity of heart.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱠᱩᱞᱦᱤ ᱫᱷᱟᱨᱮ ᱛᱮ ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱠᱚ ᱪᱚᱨᱚᱠ ᱥᱟᱡᱟᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Kulhi dhare te orag ko corok sajaw akana.
meaning: Houses along the village street are beautifully decorated.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱯᱚᱸᱰᱮᱛ ᱨᱟᱹᱜᱷᱩᱱᱟᱛᱷ ᱢᱩᱨᱢᱩ ᱫᱚ ᱚᱞ ᱪᱤᱠᱤᱭ ᱥᱤᱨᱡᱟᱹᱣ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Pandit Raghunath Murmu do Ol Chiki sirjaw keda.
meaning: Guru Gomke Pandit Raghunath Murmu created the Ol Chiki script.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱯᱱᱟᱨᱟᱜ ᱥᱟᱶᱦᱮᱫ ᱟᱨ ᱞᱟᱠᱪᱟᱨ ᱵᱟᱧᱪᱟᱣ ᱫᱚᱦᱚᱭ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Apnarag sawhed ar lakchar banchaw dohoy me.
meaning: Preserve and cherish our native literature and culture.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱛᱤᱨᱤᱭᱳ ᱟᱲᱟᱝ ᱛᱮ ᱵᱤᱨ ᱫᱤᱥᱚᱢ ᱟᱸᱫᱚᱲᱚᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Tiriyo arang te bir disom andorog kana.
meaning: The forest land echoes with the sweet voice of the bamboo flute.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱵᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱨᱮᱭᱟᱜ ᱨᱟᱦᱟ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱱᱟᱯᱟᱭ ᱟᱸᱡᱚᱢᱚᱜᱼᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Banam reyag raha adi napay anjomog-a.
meaning: The melody of the stringed Banam sounds very sweet.
Respect the wisdom and teachings of the elders.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱫᱟᱥᱟᱭ ᱫᱟᱬᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱠᱚᱲᱟ ᱠᱚ ᱵᱩᱣᱟᱝ ᱠᱚ ᱨᱩᱭᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Dasae daran re kora ko Buwang ko ruya.
meaning: During Dasae, young men play the traditional Buwang instrument.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲ ᱥᱟᱶᱛᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱟᱨ ᱥᱩᱞᱩᱠ ᱨᱮ ᱛᱷᱟᱯᱚᱱ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Santhal sawta do sari ar suluk re thapon akana.
meaning: The Santal society is founded on truth and peaceful harmony.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱤᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱥ ᱜᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱛᱮ ᱵᱟᱡᱟᱨ ᱤᱧ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Iny do bas gari te bajar iny chalag-a.
meaning: I will travel to the city by bus.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱨᱮᱞ ᱜᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱫᱚ ᱥᱮᱛᱟᱜ ᱮᱭᱟᱭ ᱴᱟᱲᱟᱝ ᱨᱮ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Rel gari do setag eyay tarang re chalag-a.
meaning: The train departs at seven o'clock in the morning.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱴᱤᱠᱤᱴ ᱚᱠᱟ ᱨᱮ ᱠᱚ ᱮᱢᱚᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
sentenceLatin: Tikit oka re ko emog kana?

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱢᱟᱱ ᱠᱚ ᱥᱟᱡᱟᱣ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱫᱚᱦᱚᱭ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Saman ko sajaw kate dohoy me.
meaning: Pack and keep the luggage ready.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱱᱚᱣᱟ ᱦᱚᱨ ᱫᱚ ᱚᱠᱟ ᱥᱮᱫ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ?
sentenceLatin: Nowa hor do oka sed chalaw akana?
meaning: Where does this road lead to?

sentenceOlChiki: ᱱᱚᱣᱟ ᱦᱚᱨ ᱫᱚ ᱨᱟᱺᱪᱤ ᱥᱮᱫ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Nowa hor do Ranchi sed chalaw akana.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱜᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱹᱭ ᱵᱟᱹᱭ ᱛᱮ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱣ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Gari do bay bay te chalaw me.
meaning: Drive the vehicle slowly and carefully.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱟᱞᱮ ᱫᱚ ᱥᱟᱭᱠᱮᱞ ᱛᱮ ᱤᱥᱠᱩᱞ ᱞᱮ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Ale do saykel te iskul le chalag-a.
meaning: We go to school by bicycle.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱛᱟᱲᱟᱢ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱪᱟᱞᱟᱜ ᱫᱚ ᱦᱚᱲᱢᱚ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱵᱮᱥ ᱜᱮᱭᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Taram kate chalag do hormo lagid bes geya.
meaning: Walking on foot is good for bodily health.
At what time will you arrive?

sentenceOlChiki: ᱦᱚᱨ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱟᱵᱽᱫᱷᱟᱱ ᱛᱮ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱ ᱢᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Hor re sabdhan te tahen me.
meaning: Stay alert and safe on the road.
The vehicle has stopped, please board.
May your journey be blessed and safe.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱡᱟᱹᱯᱩᱫ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱵᱟᱹᱫᱽ ᱠᱚ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱛᱮ ᱯᱮᱨᱮᱡᱚᱜᱼᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Japud din re bad ko dag te perejog-a.
meaning: In the monsoon season, fields get filled with water.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱨᱟᱵᱟᱝ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱞᱮ ᱫᱚ ᱞᱚᱞᱚ ᱞᱩᱜᱽᱲᱤ ᱞᱮ ᱦᱚᱨᱚᱜᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Rabang din re ale do lolo lugri le horoga.
meaning: In the winter season, we wear warm clothes.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱱᱤᱨᱚᱱ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱷᱟᱹᱨᱛᱤ ᱫᱚ ᱪᱚᱨᱚᱠ ᱧᱮᱞᱚᱜᱼᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Niron din re dharti do corok nyelog-a.
meaning: In spring season, the earth looks vibrant and charming.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱤᱛᱩᱝ ᱫᱤᱱ ᱨᱮ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱟᱹᱰᱤ ᱞᱟᱹᱠᱛᱤᱜᱼᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Situng din re dag adi laktig-a.
meaning: In the summer season, water is essential.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱛᱮᱦᱮᱧ ᱫᱚ ᱨᱤᱢᱤᱞ ᱟᱠᱟᱫᱟᱭ, ᱫᱟᱜ ᱫᱟᱲᱮᱭᱟᱜᱼᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Teheny do rimil akaday, dag dareyag-a.
meaning: Today it is cloudy, it might rain.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱦᱚᱭ ᱵᱟᱹᱨᱰᱩ ᱦᱤᱡᱩᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ, ᱚᱲᱟᱜ ᱵᱚᱞᱚᱱ ᱯᱮ᱾
sentenceLatin: Hoy bardu hijug kana, orag bolon pe.
meaning: A whirlwind/storm is coming, get inside the house.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱮᱛᱟᱜ ᱨᱮ ᱥᱤᱥᱤᱨ ᱫᱟᱜ ᱧᱩᱨᱩᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Setag re sisir dag nyurug kana.
meaning: Dew drops are falling in the morning.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱤᱸᱜᱤ ᱪᱟᱸᱫᱚ ᱨᱟᱠᱟᱵ ᱛᱮ ᱫᱷᱟᱹᱨᱛᱤ ᱢᱟᱨᱥᱟᱞ ᱮᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Singi Cando rakab te dharti marsal ena.
meaning: With the sunrise, the whole earth is illuminated with light.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱫᱟᱜ ᱡᱟᱹᱲᱤ ᱢᱩᱪᱟᱹᱫ ᱮᱱᱟ, ᱥᱮᱨᱢᱟ ᱥᱟᱯᱷᱟ ᱮᱱᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Dag jari mucad ena, serma sapha ena.
meaning: The rain shower has stopped, the sky is clear.

sentenceOlChiki: ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱢᱟᱹᱱᱢᱤ ᱥᱟᱹᱨᱤ ᱫᱷᱚᱨᱚᱢ ᱛᱮ ᱥᱩᱞᱩᱠ ᱨᱮ ᱠᱚ ᱛᱟᱦᱮᱸᱱ ᱢᱟ᱾
sentenceLatin: Sanam manmi Sari Dhorom te suluk re ko tahen ma.
meaning: May all humanity live in truth and peaceful harmony.
